title: Desktop bridge v2: AI tool detection answers ids and statuses only, first-run state round-trips through preferences.json
steps: S1: run the unit suites of the new bridges in packages/desktop/tracy-desktop (agent-manifest, shell-path, agent-detect, agents-bridge, onboarding-bridge, notify-bridge, bridge-guard, preferences).

S2: launch the app from source on the stand with TRACY_DESKTOP_ONBOARDING=again; from the page call tracyDesktop.app.agents.detect(['claude','grok','no-such-id']) until scanComplete, call detect('claude') with a bare string, then onboarding.get, onboarding.close({outcome:'dismissed', picked:'claude'}) and onboarding.get again; read the profile's preferences.json. Needs the desktop app runnable from source on this machine (the script says CANNOT RUN otherwise).
expect: S1: every suite exits 0 with 0 failures.

S2: protocolVersion is 2; claude is found once scanComplete is true; no-such-id is unsupported; every result has exactly id and status; the bare string is a TypeError; closedAt is null before close and a number after; preferences.json carries onboarding.outcome 'dismissed' and still a boolean autoCheck.
fence: The bridge returns statuses, never paths or PATH; ids are validated in main; the first-run state is device-local and survives the updater's own writes.
